hebrewText: וְ/עַתָּ֛ה אֲגַלֶּ֥ה אֶת נַבְלֻתָ֖/הּ לְ/עֵינֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ לֹֽא יַצִּילֶ֥/נָּה מִ/יָּדִֽ/י

tokens.bdb: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
tokens.kjv: henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas.

tokens.bdb: to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal
tokens.kjv: [phrase] advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, [idiom] plainly, publish, remove, reveal, [idiom] shamelessly, shew, [idiom] surely, tell, uncover.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
tokens.kjv: affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).

tokens.bdb: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).

tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.

tokens.bdb: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, [idiom] without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, [idiom] surely, take (out).
